assertion_results.text: All non-documentation intermediate tasks list the create-branch bookend task as a dependency. Documentation tasks may list implementation tasks as dependencies instead of the create-branch bookend task, since documentation depends on implementation completion
assertion_results.evidence: Task 2 Dependencies: 'Depends on: Task 1 — Create feature branch TC-9005 from main'. Task 3 Dependencies: 'Depends on: Task 1 — Create feature branch TC-9005 from main' (plus Task 2). Task 4 Dependencies: 'Depends on: Task 1 — Create feature branch TC-9005 from main' (plus Task 3). Task 5 Dependencies: 'Depends on: Task 1 — Create feature branch TC-9005 from main' (plus Task 3). Task 6 Dependencies: 'Depends on: Task 1 — Create feature branch TC-9005 from main' (plus Tasks 4, 5). All 5 non-doc intermediate tasks (2-6) list Task 1 as a dependency. Task 7 (documentation) lists Tasks 4, 5, 6 as dependencies (implementation tasks), which is the allowed alternative.

assertion_results.text: The merge-branch bookend task lists all non-documentation intermediate tasks as dependencies
assertion_results.evidence: task-8-merge-feature-branch.md Dependencies section lists: 'Task 2 — Database migration', 'Task 3 — Update entity definitions', 'Task 4 — Update advisory service and endpoints', 'Task 5 — Update ingestion pipeline', 'Task 6 — Update integration tests'. All 5 non-documentation intermediate tasks are listed. Task 7 (documentation) is correctly excluded from merge-branch dependencies.

assertion_results.text: Each non-documentation task file contains all required template sections: Repository, Target Branch, Description, at least one of Files to Modify or Files to Create, Implementation Notes, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements. Documentation tasks are exempt from requiring Files to Modify, Files to Create, and Implementation Notes — they must still include Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements
assertion_results.evidence: Non-doc, non-bookend tasks (2-6): all contain Repository (trustify-backend), Target Branch (TC-9005), Description, Files to Modify or Files to Create, Implementation Notes, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements. Task 1 (create-branch bookend): has Repository, Target Branch, Bookend Type, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements — bookend tasks omit Files to Modify/Create and Implementation Notes by design. Task 7 (documentation): has Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements — omits Files to Modify/Create and Implementation Notes as allowed. Task 8 (merge-branch bookend): has Repository, Target Branch, Bookend Type, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements.

All 8 digests verified as 64-char lowercase hex.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md Task Creation Log shows: Priority | High | Yes | 'Feature priority is set (not "Undefined") — inherited by all created tasks'. additional_fields shows '"priority": {"name": "High"}'. summary-comment.md confirms: Priority | High | Yes.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md Task Creation Log shows: fixVersions | RHTPA 2.0.0 | Yes | 'Feature has non-empty fixVersions and fixVersion scope defaults to "both" (no explicit scope in Jira Field Defaults)'. additional_fields shows '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 2.0.0"}]'. summary-comment.md confirms the same.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md file exists and contains an 'Inherited Field Propagation' section with a table showing Priority (High, propagated) and fixVersions (RHTPA 2.0.0, propagated) with reasons. The impact-map.md also contains a Task Creation Log with the same information.
